pages.name: Learning and Advancing Skills
pages.html:
Skill Training & Advancement

Spacers have a few options for advancing Skills they are trained in or for learning new Skills. All Skills require investing time into learning, with some options requiring payment. The following table shows the time and difficulty needed to learn and advance Skills.

Advancing a Skill requires having the prior rank. This means a spacer cannot jump from rank 1 to rank 3.

pages.name: Self-Guided Training
pages.html:
Self-Guided Training

Self-Guided Training: If a spacer has an INT DM of 0 or more, they can attempt to do self-guided training using a ship’s computer as a form of correspondence school or by using study programs. Spacers can purchase education programs in any Class C starport or higher and install them on their ship’s computer. To learn a new Skill, the spacer must commit eight weeks of dedicated study time (typically during a jump) and must succeed on an 8+ check modified by EDU. The difficulty decreases by one step every even level of the Skill, as indicated on the table.

  • Cost: Each program costs 2500cr per Skill rank, starting at rank 0.
  • Success: The spacer has learned a new Skill at rank 0.
  • Failure: The spacer does not learn the new Skill but may try again after spending one half the time needed to learn the skill.
  • Limitations: A spacer cannot self instruct themselves in a Skill higher than their INT DM.

Book p.122

pages.name: Hiring an Instructor
pages.html:
Hiring an Instructor

Hiring an Instructor: An instructor decreases training time by four weeks and allows the spacer to decrease the learning check by one step. For example if the check to learn a Skill is 8+, then it is 6+ with an instructor.

  • Cost: An instructor typically costs 5,000cr (D3+3 x 1000) per month of dedicated training.
  • Limitations: An instructor must know the Skill at an equal level or a higher level than what the spacer is attempting to learn. For example, an NPC with Survival 1 cannot instruct a spacer to learn Survival 2.

Book p.122

pages.name: Personal Improvement
pages.html:
Personal Improvement

Personal Improvement: A spacer can choose to commit to personal improvement either mentally or physically. A spacer can only commit to improving one score at a time and cannot also undertake training for a Skill simultaneously.

  • Increase education: Increase your education score by undertaking a correspondence course while travelling. Enrolling in a course costs 70,000cr up front and requires a weekly commitment to studying for 50 weeks. At the end of the course, roll 8+ modified by intelligence. On a success, education (EDU) increases by 1.
  • Increasing intelligence: Intelligence increases with age and experience. Once a spacer reaches 36, every year thereafter their intelligence (INT) may increase by +1 on a successful roll of 10+, with a DM of +1 for every decade of life over 40 years of age. Intelligence cannot be naturally increased by more than 15.
  • Conditioning: If a spacer would like to increase any one of their physical abilities, they can choose to take on a physical training regimen. The amount of time needed to increase DEX, STR, or END requires a number of weeks of training equal to their current ability score. After the committed weeks of training, roll 8+ to have the score increase by +1.
